evals.prompt: I need to add a new DsPrimaryButton atom to our Flutter Design System package. Where exactly do I create the implementation file, the test file, and the Widgetbook story?
evals.expected_output: Shows lib/src/atoms/buttons/ds_primary_button.dart, test/atoms/buttons/ds_primary_button_test.dart, and widgetbook path from structure.widgetbook_components_path. Reminds to export from public barrel file.

assertions.text: Response places the atom implementation in lib/src/atoms/buttons/ or similar atoms subfolder
Response mirrors the lib/src structure in the test/ folder for the test file
Response mentions exporting the new component from the public barrel file

evals.prompt: I'm creating a new ProductDetailView screen for the app (not the DS package). This screen is large and needs a private hero section widget and a content list widget. Where do I place all these files?
evals.expected_output: Views go in lib/src/presentation/views/product_detail/ subfolder. Private section widgets go in the same subfolder with underscore prefix. Not exported from DS barrel. Test goes in test/presentation/views/product_detail/.

assertions.text: Response places the view in lib/src/presentation/views/ and creates a subfolder for the view
Response places private section widgets in the same view subfolder with underscore prefix
Response clarifies that views do NOT get the DS prefix and are NOT exported from the DS barrel

evals.prompt: A colleague is adding code to lib/atoms/buttons/ but our DS package is configured with lib/src/atoms/buttons/. What should I tell them?
evals.expected_output: Explains the implementation source must be in lib/src. If a legacy layout exists (lib/atoms), register an alert and keep new code in lib/src path. The public barrel file exports from lib/src.

assertions.text: Response identifies lib/src as the correct location for all DS implementation code
Response mentions registering an alert if a legacy layout structure is detected
Response explains the public barrel file should export only from lib/src
